## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical negotiation in a real product scenario where business pressure clashes with privacy constraints. It probes your ability to surface interests, mediate, and formalize a remediation plan without stalling the release.

- Stakeholder mapping and interest-based negotiation
- Privacy by design and data minimization

};

- How would you measure success of the chosen option post-launch?
- How would you handle a stakeholder change request after kickoff?
